votes.motion: MOVED TO ADOPT ORDINANCE 2025-13. THE MOTION DIED FOR LACK OF A SECOND. Council member Graf stated that the assumption has been made that there is no commercial viability for the subject property, but he believes there are some different uses that would fit on the property, and he referenced a few similar properties in Salt Lake City that have been used for attractive commercial or office space uses. He has concerns about access to the property and believes the viability of a residential zone change and development would be improved at some point in the future.
ON A MOTION BY VICE CHAIR HYER AND SECONDED BY COUNCIL MEMBER GRAF, ORDINANCE 2025-13 WAS REJECTED
